title: Bound on work-head movement
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes. For any tape index $i$ among those tapes, the head position on tape $i$ changes by at most one in absolute value after one step of $M$ relative to $O$: $\left|p_i'-p_i\right|\le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
A tape index $i$ among the $k+1$ tapes
replaced:
Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, $O$ an oracle
language, $c$ a configuration, and $i$ one of the $k+1$ work-tape indices.
Then the position of the $i$-th work head after one step of $M$ relative to
$O$ differs from its position in $c$ by at most $1$ in absolute value.
